title: Neighbourhood flood damage amplifies mortgage default cascades
abstract: arXiv:2611.29652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Floods threaten mortgage repayment by damaging homes, disrupting incomes, and worsening conditions in surrounding neighbourhoods. However, it remains unclear how these neighbourhood effects turn local damage into systemic mortgage distress, as Europe's housing crisis leaves households that lose their homes with few affordable alternatives. Using an agent-based model calibrated to Limburg, the Netherlands, we show that damage to surrounding properties can trigger mortgage defaults among households that can still afford to pay, including those whose own homes remain undamaged. In the most severe flood scenario, the annual foreclosure rate more than doubles. As each foreclosure lowers the value of nearby homes, it triggers a cascade. Floods make such large foreclosure cascades more frequent, with the share of foreclosures that belong to these cascades rising from 31% to 45%. translated_title: 社区洪水损害会放大抵押贷款违约级联效应
translated_abstract: 洪水通过损坏房屋、扰乱收入来源并恶化周边社区环境，威胁抵押贷款的偿还。然而，这些邻里效应如何将局部损害转化为系统性抵押贷款困境仍不清楚，因为欧洲的住房危机使得失去住房的家庭几乎没有可负担的替代选择。本文使用一个以荷兰林堡省校准的基于主体的模型（agent-based model），研究表明周边房产的损害可能引发那些仍有能力还款的家庭的抵押贷款违约，甚至包括自身房屋未受损的家庭。在最严重的洪水情景下，年止赎率翻了一倍以上。由于每一次止赎都会降低附近房屋的价值，从而触发级联效应。洪水使这类大规模止赎级联变得更加频繁，属于此类级联的止赎比例从31%上升到45%。洪水还使止赎向较年轻的抵押贷款转移……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文利用校准于荷兰林堡省的基于主体模型发现，洪水导致的周边社区房产损害会通过压低邻近房屋价值触发止赎级联效应，使年止赎率翻倍以上、大规模级联中止赎占比从31%升至45%，甚至波及房屋未受损且仍有还款能力的家庭。
en_tdlr: Using an agent-based model calibrated to Limburg, the Netherlands, this paper shows that neighbourhood flood damage amplifies mortgage default cascades—each foreclosure depresses nearby home values and triggers further defaults, more than doubling annual foreclosure rates and even hitting households whose own homes are undamaged and who can still afford to pay.
